The wastewater treatment processes of the Civic Center Facility include coarse and fine mechanical screening and grit removal for preliminary treatment of the influent wastewater.
The effluent after the preliminary treatment flows to an equalization basin.
The effluent of an equalization basin will flow to a Membrane Bioreactor (MBR) consisting of biological reactors and membrane-based solids removal.
The MBR will provide carbonaceous oxidation, nitrificationidenitrification and solids removal to meet the limits of the WDRsWRRs.
Disinfection of the treated effluent will be achieved by Ultraviolet (UV) disinfection.

Disinfection will be followed by the addition of chlorine to maintain a chlorine residual in the distribution system to minimize microorganisms re-growth and bio-fouling in the pipelines and injection welts.

Three (3) percolation ponds (Figure 2) in the Winter Canyon area are to be constructed at the site of the Civic Center Facility as a back-up method for disposal of recycled water into the Winter Canyon groundwater basin.
